jobs.jobDescription:
• Executive Assistant to the CEO


    Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer in making the best use of his time across a global business. Based in New York, you will own his calendar, travel, and day-to-day coordination, working closely with our Workplace team in Brussels and Collibrians across the company.

    The CEO will be your primary focus. You will also manage scheduling, travel, and expenses for the Chief People Officer and Chief Technology Officer, with the CEO’s needs taking priority when requests overlap.

    This role suits someone who enjoys the art and science of executive support: understanding priorities, anticipating needs, and getting the details right. You will have significant autonomy to resolve scheduling and logistical issues, with the judgment to know when to involve the CEO.

    Location and schedule

    Our CEO splits his time between Brussels and New York, working on a European schedule approximately half the time. This role is based in our New York City Financial District office, with at least four days per week in office and a regular schedule that aligns with his location. All hours below are Eastern Time.

    • When the CEO is in Europe: Monday - Thursday, 6:00 - 9:00 a.m. remote and 10:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. in office. Fridays are fully remote, 6:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m.
    • When the CEO is in the US: Monday – Thursday, 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. in office, with Fridays remote, unless needed in office.

    Supporting a global CEO requires availability beyond these regular hours. You will be expected to monitor and respond to time-sensitive needs in the early mornings, evenings, and on weekends, including changes to travel, scheduling, and other urgent requests.


    The Executive Assistant to the CEO at Collibra is responsible for

    • Managing the CEO’s calendar across multiple time zones, assessing requests for his time, resolving conflicts, and keeping his schedule aligned with business priorities.
    • Managing the Executive Committee’s (ExCom) meeting cadence, coordinating agendas and advance materials, documenting decisions, and tracking action items and follow-through.
    • Managing the preparation and process for executive strategic planning sessions, including timelines, pre-work, facilitator guides, and draft working materials, and capturing decisions and next steps.
    • Managing coordination and tracking for the Executive Sponsor Program, which connects senior leaders with strategic accounts, partnering with account teams to prepare executives and track commitments and follow-up.
    • Maintaining a central record of CEO customer meetings and other executive customer engagements, including briefing materials, key discussion points, decisions, and follow-up, so teams can build on previous interactions.
    • Planning an preparing the CEO for stakeholder meetings, and media or speaking engagements by gathering and synthesizing input from partners into concise briefings, and maintaining a central record of executive customer engagements, key discussion points, commitments, and follow-up.
    • Building and maintaining reusable AI-powered workflows to support executive preparation, meeting documentation, and follow-up, with appropriate safeguards for confidential information and human review.
    • Arranging domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries, and responding quickly when plans change.
    • Managing expenses and coordinating procurement, vendor, and approval workflows through Navan and Zip, ensuring submissions are accurate and processed on time.
    • Coordinating logistics for leadership meetings, offsites, and executive events, partnering with internal teams.
    • Managing scheduling, travel, and expenses for the Chief People Officer and Chief Technology Officer.
    • Building trusted relationships across the business to gather context, coordinate requests and legal document signatures, and keep administrative work moving.
    • Welcoming visitors and coordinating executive meetings in the New York office.
    • Handling occasional personal requests with discretion and professionalism.


    You have

    • 8+ years of experience supporting senior executives, including a CEO or other C-suite executive, with experience balancing the needs of multiple executives.
    • Experience managing executive team meeting processes and cross-functional programs, including preparing working materials, documenting decisions, and following up with senior leaders on commitments.
    • Extensive experience managing complex calendars and international travel across multiple time zones. Experience supporting a Europe-based or globally distributed executive is a strong plus.
    • Hands-on experience building repeatable AI workflows beyond one-off prompting. You can structure reusable context and instructions, set up AI projects, and automate recurring work using agents or similar tools. You should be prepared to walk through a specific workflow you built, explain how you tested its reliability, and describe how you handled sensitive information.
    • Excellent judgment and a demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential information, including Board-level materials and sensitive business and people matters.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into clear, concise executive briefing materials.
    • A track record of anticipating needs, resolving competing priorities independently, and following through as circumstances change.
    • Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including preparing executive-level presentations and maintaining spreadsheets.
    • Experience using travel, expense, procurement, and electronic signature platforms such as Navan, Zip, and DocuSign, alongside collaboration tools such as Slack and Zoom.
    • Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes.
    • A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience is required.
    • Experience working in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.
    • Fluency in Dutch or French is preferred.
    • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.


    You are

    • Highly organized and dependable, with a keen eye for detail and an understanding of the priorities behind the work.
    • Calm under pressure, able to adapt quickly and make thoughtful decisions as plans change.
    • Proactive and resourceful, comfortable taking ownership, solving problems independently, and knowing when to ask for input.
    • Warm, professional, and respectfully direct, able to build trusted relationships across levels, locations, and time zones.
    • Curious about better ways of working and willing to experiment, while applying sound judgment about accuracy and confidentiality.
    • Comfortable handling both complex coordination and routine administrative tasks with care.
    • Discreet and trustworthy, handling sensitive information and requests with professionalism.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.jobDescription:
A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

Position Overview

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) serves as a strategic business partner responsible for maximizing the effectiveness, focus, and operational efficiency of a global revenue executive. This role extends well beyond traditional administrative support and requires strong business acumen, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, revenue-driven environment.

The Executive Assistant acts as an extension of the CRO's office, ensuring priorities are surfaced, decisions are supported, communication flows effectively, and critical business initiatives remain on track. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational skills, proactive problem-solving, discretion, and the ability to coordinate across global teams and stakeholders.

Location: Boston-based or nearby (ideal) / Eastern Time preferred

Requirements:

  • Flexibility to support a globally distributed leadership team across time zones
  • Current passport and ability to travel as needed
  • Availability to respond to time-sensitive business matters outside standard business hours when required

Key Responsibilities

Executive Partnership & Leadership Support

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the CRO.
  • Anticipate needs, identify potential challenges, and proactively develop solutions.
  • Optimize the CRO's time, focus, and decision-making through effective prioritization and coordination.
  • Manage and triage executive communications, ensuring critical priorities receive timely attention.
  • Raise emerging priorities, flag risks, bottlenecks, and delays, and drive appropriate follow-up.
  • Prepare executive briefings, agendas, meeting materials, and decision-support documents.
  • Track key initiatives, commitments, action items, and deliverables to ensure accountability and execution.
  • Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

Executive Inbox & Communication Management

  • Proactively manage the CRO's inbox and communication flow.
  • Prioritize incoming requests, identify urgent matters, and ensure timely responses.
  • Surface critical business issues requiring executive attention.
  • Draft communications and coordinate follow-up across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Monitor commitments and escalate unresolved items that may impact business objectives.

Global Calendar Management

  • Own and manage a highly complex global calendar spanning multiple time zones.
  • Balance executive leadership meetings, customer engagements, board interactions, investor meetings, travel schedules, and strategic priorities.
  • Exercise strong judgment when managing scheduling conflicts and competing demands.
  • Coordinate effectively with executives, sales leaders, customers, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure the CRO's time is aligned to the highest-value business opportunities and revenue priorities.

Global Travel Management

  • Plan and execute complex domestic and international travel arrangements.
  • Develop optimized travel schedules that maximize customer engagement and business impact.
  • Coordinate flights, accommodations, transportation, visas, travel documentation, and contingency plans.
  • Partner with regional teams to ensure productive and efficient travel itineraries.
  • Manage travel disruptions and last-minute changes with urgency and professionalism.

Event & Meeting Management

  • Lead the planning and execution of executive-level meetings and events, including:
    • Global Sales Meetings
    • Customer and Partner Events
    • Sales Leadership Offsites
    • Executive Roundtables and Dinners
    • Revenue Organization Meetings
  • Manage venues, vendors, budgets, communications, logistics, attendee coordination, and executive preparation.
  • Deliver seamless event experiences that support business objectives and stakeholder engagement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a central coordination point across the revenue organization.
  • Build strong relationships with executive leadership, sales leaders, customers, partners, and cross-functional teams.
  • Facilitate communication, alignment, and follow-through across distributed teams.
  • Represent the CRO's office with professionalism, credibility, and sound judgment.
  • Drive execution by ensuring stakeholders remain informed, aligned, and accountable.

Administrative & Operational Excellence

  • Manage expenses, invoices, procurement activities, and administrative processes.
  • Support leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and organizational initiatives.
  • Maintain operational trackers, reporting tools, and executive workflows.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance executive effectiveness.
  • Establish and maintain systems that improve visibility into priorities, commitments, and follow-up actions.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational, planning, and prioritization abilities.
  • Advanced executive calendar and travel management expertise.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities with sound judgment.
  • Experience supporting high-growth, fast-paced organizations.
  • Ability to proactively identify issues, risks, and dependencies.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • High degree of discretion and professionalism.
  • Ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Comfortable operating across multiple time zones and global teams.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly changing environments.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience supporting senior executives, preferably within revenue, sales, or go-to-market organizations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting global leadership teams.
  • Significant experience planning and executing executive-level meetings and events.
  • Extensive experience coordinating complex domestic and international travel.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and modern productivity tools.
  • Experience working with confidential business information and executive communications.

Working Style & Expectations

  • Highly proactive and solutions-oriented.
  • Operates with urgency while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
  • Anticipates needs rather than reacting to requests.
  • Comfortable making decisions and exercising independent judgment.
  • Maintains composure under pressure and during periods of ambiguity.
  • Acts as a trusted extension of the CRO's leadership office.
  • Demonstrates flexibility to support global business needs and executive priorities.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The CRO's time is consistently aligned to strategic and revenue-generating priorities.
  • Critical communications, decisions, and follow-ups are managed proactively.
  • Inbox management is efficient, organized, and focused on business impact.
  • Risks, delays, and bottlenecks are identified and escalated before they become issues.
  • Global travel and executive events run seamlessly.
  • Stakeholders experience clear communication, strong coordination, and timely execution.
  • Business priorities remain visible, organized, and moving forward.

We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - and behind every high-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high-trust, hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier - down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership - managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day-to-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

In this role, you will:

  • Own calendars and time allocation for finance leadership team, making trade-off calls independently against stated priorities

  • Prepare executives for every meeting: pre-reads, context, and the decision needed - including board and investor sessions

  • Capture actions out of meetings and chase them to completion

  • Triage executive inboxes and draft correspondence

  • Automate the mechanical parts of the role - briefing prep, triage, scheduling, recurring reporting

  • Run discrete projects: board logistics, executive travel, offsites, and the finance team's operating cadence

Requirements

  • Experience supporting multiple senior executives in a high-velocity environment

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders

jobs.jobDescription:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We’re looking for a resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support two Vice Presidents across our UK business and EMEA Technology organisation. In this role, you’ll help leaders operate effectively by managing calendars, coordinating travel and events, supporting meeting preparation, and maintaining strong documentation and record-keeping practices.

You’ll partner closely with teams in the UK and internationally, including the Affirm Leadership Support Team, and cross-functional partners across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP, Country Manager UK and the VP, EU Engineering

What You’ll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents

  • Manage inboxes, calendars, scheduling, and meeting prioritisation to help leaders use their time effectively

  • Co-ordinate core meetings in the daily / weekly / monthly operating plan for both leaders, ensuring attendance, drafting and distributing agendas, preparing materials, creating decks / notion pages, communicating with attendees and ensuring follow up actions are shared in a timely manner and tracked to completion.

  • Manage incoming correspondence, including email and physical mail, and coordinate timely intake and forwarding from the managed office facility

  • Ensure leaders are fully prepared for all core meetings that they attend linking all relevant documentation into calendar invites and providing timely reminders, blocking off time in diaries to ensure sufficient preparation and review time.

  • Co-ordinate team events, team-building activities, and onsite/offsite meetings in various locations, including travel as needed.

  • Ensure monthly in-office days are planned and well attended, including booking office space, organising food and refreshments, ensuring AV equipment is available and operational.

  • Plan and co-ordinate all travel for both VPs in good time ensuring tracking, monitoring and communication of any delays , cancellations and changes to travel plans.

  • Support and complete expense reporting and travel coordination through Navan travel system

  • Prepare documents and presentations using Google Suite and Microsoft Office develop skills of AI tools

  • Provide administrative support and coordination for UK and EMEA projects and programmes as needed

  • Pro-actively engage and develop effective ways of working utilising AI tools.

  • Work collaboratively with the support team across the business, providing cover where needed and ensuring cover is planned during planned time off.

What We Look For

  • 8+ years of relevant executive support experience

  • Experience supporting Board level leaders in a fast-paced, dynamic, and cross-functional environment

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, functions, and markets

  • Comfortable and proven experience of working in a remote environment

  • Complete discretion and confidentiality in all matters

  • Excellent judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information

  • Outstanding organisational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Experience providing clerk or administrative support for Board and/or sub-committee meetings

  • Experience working in or supporting a regulated UK business

  • Working knowledge of Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Navan, Notion, and Zoom

  • Working knowledge of workplace AI tools - Codex and Claude

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and lean into ad hoc projects and requests

  • Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive feedback diplomatically

  • Willingness to travel when required, including some international travel

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: H

Equity Grade: UK 1

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £61,000–£99,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - and behind every high-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high-trust, hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier - down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership - managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day-to-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

In this role, you will:

  • Own calendars and time allocation for revenue leadership team, making trade-off calls independently against stated priorities

  • Prepare executives for every meeting: pre-reads, context, and the decision needed - including board and investor sessions

  • Capture actions out of meetings and chase them to completion

  • Triage executive inboxes and draft correspondence

  • Automate the mechanical parts of the role - briefing prep, triage, scheduling, recurring reporting

  • Run discrete projects: board logistics, executive travel, offsites, and the revenue team's operating cadence

Requirements

  • Experience supporting multiple senior executives in a high-velocity environment

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests

  • Proven judgment and problem-solving skills

  • Fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating your own work - come ready to show what you've built

  • High emotional intelligence and discretion - trusted with sensitive information

  • Fluency in English

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to senior executives across Solace’s leadership team, including C-suite leaders and Vice Presidents, specifically within our Finance Department. This role is a strategic partner responsible for enabling executives to operate efficiently, stay focused on high-impact priorities, and maintain strong operational cadence across the organization.

You’ll manage complex calendars, meetings, communication flow, travel, and executive coordination, while also supporting leadership events, offsites, and cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to anticipate needs before they arise. This is a high-trust, high-visibility role that is foundational to Solace’s ability to scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own complex, multi-time-zone calendar management, prioritizing meetings based on urgency, impact, and strategic value.

  • Protect executive time by triaging inbound requests, managing hold blocks, and proactively resolving scheduling conflicts.

  • Support the planning and execution of leadership meetings, team offsites, and large-scale company events.

  • Act as a proxy in meetings when needed, capturing detailed notes, clarifying decisions, and driving follow-through on action items.

  • Draft, edit, and send communications on behalf of executives with professionalism, clarity, and strong executive presence.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact between executives and internal leaders, external partners, vendors, and stakeholders.

  • Digest, summarize, and escalate key information, updates, risks, or insights while maintaining strict confidentiality.

  • Support leadership operating cadence (staff meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, offsites) by owning agendas, note-taking, action tracking, and follow-through.

  • Build and continuously improve systems, templates, and processes that enhance executive productivity and organizational effectiveness.

  • Manage end-to-end travel logistics, itineraries, reservations, and expense reporting with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Ensure seamless operational execution during high-volume periods, travel, or periods of rapid change.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience supporting senior executives, preferably at the VP or C-suite level in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with a fintech startup or financial firm.

  • Exceptional calendar management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, concise executive-level messaging.

  • Demonstrated judgment, professionalism, and ability to handle highly confidential information.

  • Excellent project management skills with a strong bias toward execution and follow-through.

  • Ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and stay ahead of deadlines.

  • Comfort operating in a dynamic, sometimes ambiguous environment while maintaining calm and clarity.

  • High EQ and ability to navigate cross-functional relationships with empathy, tact, and confidence.

Bonus Points

  • Background in startups, healthcare, technology, finance or complex operational environments.

  • Finance-focused Executive Assistant support for Finance C-suite leaders (like a CFO) and Vice Presidents.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

jobs.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Executive Assistants and Corporate Administrators to join our Corporate Operations team. We ensure that the business runs smoothly and that travel, expenses and events are efficiently and correctly managed.

We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.

This team plays a crucial role in the overall operation of the business. They run significant business operations and processes, supporting the respective department leads but also taking central responsibility for logistics, expenses, travel and scheduling. They are the secret to our success! We look for confident and effective people who have good judgment and the self-assurance to hold firm on a point of policy regardless of the seniority of people on the other side of a discussion. If you like to take responsibility and you like to ensure that things are done properly and efficiently then you will enjoy the role tremendously.

Location: This is a global operation, we have open roles in teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Support operations for one or more departments in the company
  • Coordinate monthly reports and schedule meetings and interviews
  • Organise and run international company events including logistics
  • Manage quarterly and annual executive meetings
  • Collaborate across teams on activities and initiatives
  • Manage suppliers and stakeholders

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • A degree in a business or technical subject
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Responsibility, integrity and accountability
  • Self-awareness and thoughtfulness
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
  • Ability to learn new technology and software quickly

Additional skills we value

  • Experience in operations and executive support
  • Project management experience
  • Event related experience
  • Travel industry experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

#LI-remote

Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!

As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.

You will review ads in both English and Spanish

This role is great for people who:

- Surf the internet daily

- Use major search engines frequently

- Know what people want based on a few keywords

- Enjoy researching topics online

- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details

Job Title: Ads Quality Rater

Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $4 per hour)

Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Argentina

Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed

Project Duration: Long-term

Note:

- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

Recruitment Process

- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.

- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).

Experience & Requirements

  • Fluency in Spanish
  • Strong understanding of English (written and spoken)
  • Comfortable knowledge of modern popular culture
  • Reliable computer system and internet connection
  • Familiar with using online search engines
  • Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Compensation

Additional Information

Welo Data

When you join Welo Data, you have the opportunity to bring your career to the next level.

- We offer a great variety of unique and interesting projects in a multicultural and international environment

- We focus on building long-term, supportive relationships with all of our partners

- Our projects offer excellent professional development opportunities that empower your career learning and growth

- You'll receive human support from our Community Team 24 hours per day, 6 days per week

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, take a moment to apply below!

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

  • Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.
  • Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.
  • Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.
  • Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical discussions with teammates to identify gaps in our telematics data platform and influence roadmap by setting direction and recommending solutions
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to make design decisions and understand downstream implications in our product to ensure a seamless customer experience
  • Ship features that deliver value to customers, consistently refining them based on gathered feedback.
  • Deliver full stack features across multiple tiers (front-end, back-end and mobile). GoLang, GraphQL, Typescript, React and ReactNative among other technologies. Direct experience with these technologies is not required.
  • Be responsible for maintaining the production systems that your team owns and provide operational support.
  • Make an impact on our core architecture, roadmap, and the wider engineering community.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on work building and operating complex enterprise systems.
  • A track record of turning partially defined customer or business challenges into technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes with substantial autonomy.
  • Strong system design judgment, including service boundaries, dependencies, failure modes, performance, and safe changes to production systems.
  • Experience leading delivery through deep ownership of a critical system or coordination across multiple services and teams, balancing immediate needs with long-term architecture.
  • Ability to improve other engineers’ effectiveness through mentoring, design reviews, and clear technical decisions.
  • Extensive use of AI throughout engineering, including complex investigations and design exploration, with the ability to validate results and help teammates adopt effective workflows.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building customer-facing web and mobile workflow applications
  • Contributed heavily to driving significant value to their customers
  • Curiosity about our customers, and is eager to improve their day-to-day experience
  • Seeks to iterate on new products based on customer feedback
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.Strong communication skills for effective teamwork and project collaboration.
  • Enthusiastic and committed to innovating in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment.
  • Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from enterprise-scale, production work.
    • Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.
    • Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.
    • Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.
    • Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.
    • Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

638 350 zł—751 000 zł PLN

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Location: Remote — United States (Open to applicants located anywhere in the United States.)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a SEO & Analytics Strategist at Fueled, you will be part of Fueled’s Digital Growth Strategy team, helping our clients implement actionable strategies that positively impact and measure their business goals and desired audience outcomes.

You’re motivated by solving complex problems and helping clients find the right path forward through data-driven solutions and practical, easy-to-understand insights. You look beyond surface metrics to uncover what truly drives discovery, engagement, and conversion, and turn those findings into measurable impact. In this role, you’ll contribute to a mix of enterprise-level projects and ongoing engagements that continue to sharpen your skills, working with a diverse client base that includes innovative startups, nonprofits, and global organizations across media, technology, healthcare, and mission-driven sectors.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Drive long-term discoverability and growth by shaping SEO and AI search (GEO/AIO) strategies that expand brand visibility across traditional search and AI-driven answer engines.
  • Strengthen digital foundations by translating technical, content, and structured data insights into prioritized optimization roadmaps that improve site authority and machine readability.
  • Influence how brands appear in AI and search ecosystems by guiding entity, content, and trust-signal enhancements that improve citation, attribution, and accuracy in AI-generated results.
  • Connect strategy to business impact by designing measurement frameworks and experimentation approaches that tie search and content performance to client goals and revenue outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional growth initiatives by partnering with clients and delivery teams to turn insights into scalable recommendations that extend beyond a single project or channel.

What you will achieve:

  • Measurably increase qualified organic and AI-driven visibility, traffic, and engagement across client digital properties.
  • Deliver optimization roadmaps that result in sustained improvements to crawlability, indexation, structured data coverage, and AI readability scores.
  • Improve how client brands and content are surfaced and cited in AI-generated experiences and search features.
  • Establish clear, trusted measurement models that connect search and content efforts to conversion and revenue impact.
  • Produce repeatable, insight-led growth wins through testing and experimentation that inform broader client strategy and future engagements.

About you:

  • You bring strong, hands-on experience in SEO, audience growth, and analytics, and use that foundation to turn search and performance insights into practical, high-impact actions.
  • You know how to use leading SEO and audit tools and, more importantly, translate findings into clear, prioritized recommendations that teams can realistically implement.
  • You understand how AI and LLM-driven search works and apply that knowledge to improve discoverability beyond traditional SERPs.
  • You’re confident with analytics and tracking frameworks, using GA4, GTM, and visualization tools to produce insights that guide decisions and prove impact.
  • You collaborate and communicate effectively, seeking cross-team input and explaining complex technical ideas in clear, concise language to any audience.

Contractor Fee

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs.

Join our Contractor Pool

This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles.

If you are passionate about Fueled’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don’t check all the boxes – please apply. We’d appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you’ll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. The SEO & AEO function specifically drives organic discovery ensuring Stripe is found, cited, and recommended when developers, founders, and finance leaders are searching for or asking about payments, financial infrastructure, and related topics.

What you’ll do

This role owns one of the most strategically important and evolving acquisition channels at Stripe. Organic search is already one of our largest and most efficient growth channels and the emergence of AI-powered answer engines represents a once-in-a-generation shift in how businesses discover software. The role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of content, product, engineering, and data and who can credibly engage with Stripe's executive team on the strategic importance of organic visibility. This is a rare opportunity to define what AEO means for a company like Stripe and to build the playbook that others will follow.

Responsibilities

  • Own the organic growth strategy end-to-end across SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), including technical optimizations, content strategy, on-site experience, and visibility in general purpose assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) and coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of SEO and AEO specialists, fostering a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and continuous learning
  • Drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, rankings, citations, traffic, signups, sales inbound and downstream activations across both AEO and SEO
  • Drive measurable improvements in how well AI tools are able to understand how Stripe’s products work and how to properly integrate them
  • Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, content, growth, data science, and marketing to embed SEO/AEO best practices across Stripe's web properties, documentation, and product surfaces
  • Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO and AEO: develop attribution models, define leading/lagging indicators, and quantify the revenue impact of organic channels
  • Own strategic roadmap for AEO: establish Stripe's point of view on how AI-generated answers reshape discovery, and position Stripe to win
  • Drive improvements across content quality, website architecture, and structured data to maximize discoverability
  • Represent organic growth performance and strategy across Stripe: translating complex technical SEO/AEO concepts into clear business impact narratives

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in SEO, with at least 3 years leading a team and 2+ years at a senior/leadership level engaging with executives
  • Demonstrated expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, with a track record of driving significant organic growth at scale
  • Deep understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines work (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition) and a clear point of view on how to optimize for them
  • Ability to drive improvements across multiple levers: content, website architecture, product surfaces, structured data, measurement, and cross-functional influence
  • Strong analytical foundation: comfortable with data, attribution challenges, and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels
  • Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and build strategic alignment around organic growth investment
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO/AEO improvements at scale
  • Track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with developer-focused or technical B2B products where documentation, API references, and technical content are significant organic surfaces
  • Background in international SEO strategy, including managing organic growth across multiple markets and languages
  • Experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale (e.g., template pages, user-generated content, dynamic landing pages)
  • Demonstrated early-mover advantage in AEO evidence of monitoring, optimizing for, or measuring visibility in AI-generated answers
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven culture where you must build the case for investment through data and strategic narrative

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

Why this role matters:

As a Sales Development Representative you will be responsible for creating, identifying, and qualifying new Mid-Market sales opportunities. Your final goal will be to schedule meetings with qualified prospects, and pass them on to our Mid-Market Sales counterparts.

You will be the very first point of contact a potential customer will have with Vonage API and play a vital role not only in generating sales pipeline, but helping us refine sales and marketing strategy based on your interactions and successes with prospects.

There are tremendous growth opportunities within this position and team; you will have a chance to learn and develop skills on B2B technology sales and marketing and more. We are growing rapidly and we expect our SDRs to grow to more senior positions across the organization as we gain experience and achieve higher levels of performance.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Perform outbound prospecting activities, and contact potential clients through phone/video calls, emails, LinkedIn or other channels
  • Discover new leads through creative internet research and social media monitoring/messaging, using LinkedIn Navigator and other sales tools
  • Qualify customers based on a thorough knowledge of Vonage API platform products
  • Keep meticulous and detailed notes updated in our CRM system
  • Schedule qualified meetings and demos for our Account Managers
  • Collaborate with marketing, account managers, and sales leadership to optimize performance
  • Achieve monthly targets number of qualified Appointments & new sales Opportunities
  • Develop and maintain territory plan with Account Managers from your assigned geography
  • Have strong working product knowledge of Vonage’s API product suites
  • Support Vonage API marketing efforts by assisting in online and other marketing campaigns

Required:

  • Ability to speak and write English at a professional level
  • Strong Cold calling and Personalized email creation experience
  • Self Motivated and Self Organized with the ability to make things happen without supervision or tight control

  • Highly collaborative mindset who is a team player - our success is together, not alone.
  • Willingness to talk on the phone and on video with prospects
  • Ability to work at a fast pace to have as many meaningful interactions with prospects as possible each day
  • Goal-oriented mindset
  • Creativity around new ideas to help the team be successful

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

  • Group Life Insurance
  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. jobs.jobDescription:
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Associate Product Operations Manager to support our Product organization in improving operational efficiency, cross-functional alignment, and consistency in how work moves through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). Working closely with, and at the direction of, the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team, this role will execute the day-to-day tactics that keep our Product Operating Model running smoothly, while building the experience and judgment to take on greater ownership over time.

  • Align: work closely with the Product Leadership, Senior Product Operations Manager, Product Managers, and cross-functional business partners to help ensure product work is clearly understood, decisions are communicated effectively, and teams stay aligned on priorities, dependencies, and readiness.
  • Enable: Help provide product teams with the means to complete routine and strategic tasks as efficiently as possible, by supporting key processes, maintaining tools and workflows, and bringing structure to how work is prepared, reviewed, and tracked.
  • Improve: Support continuous, iterative improvement of how teams work by helping identify bottlenecks, reducing time spent on non-core product activities, and reinforcing the systems, governance, and operating rhythms that support high-quality product work.

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Operations is a multifaceted function that focuses on improving how the Product organization operates day to day, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enabling product teams to focus on what they do best: build great products. This role is a mixture of hands-on execution and support for continuous improvement, working under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team. In this role you will be responsible
for:

  • Product Operating Model and Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) Support: Support the flow of work from intake through discovery, assessment, planning, and delivery by helping ensure requests are complete, handoffs are clear, and the right information is available at the right time.
  • Intake and Initiative Readiness: Support the intake process by serving as a first line of review for incoming requests. Work with stakeholders to gather required inputs and help ensure work is ready for Product review and decision-making.
  • Operating Rhythm and Meeting Support: Help prepare, coordinate, and, where appropriate, facilitate recurring forums such as Weekly Business Reviews, roadmap reviews, stakeholder meetings, and leadership sessions. Ensure materials are organized, decisions are captured, and follow-up actions are tracked to completion.
  • Tools and Workflow Optimization: Maintain the product management tech stack, including workflow hygiene, documentation practices, and reporting accuracy, and flag opportunities to improve transparency and usability across Product and cross-functional teams.
  • Governance and Process Support: Support key operating processes including compliance reviews, cross-functional readiness, and other recurring governance needs that help the business interact effectively with Product.
  • Cross-functional Project and Program Support: Support the execution of select cross-functional initiatives directed by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Managers, helping track alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across teams.
  • Data-informed Execution: Help gather and organize data, reporting, and operational insights to support the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership in identifying trends and informing process improvements.
  • Iterative Improvement: Help ensure product operating processes, frameworks, and methodologies remain practical and fit for purpose. Support the rollout of improvements as directed, with a bias toward progress over perfection.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support open communication and help facilitate alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders, ensuring teams are working effectively toward common goals.
  • Team Support: Support onboarding, training, and documentation efforts led by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership, helping build repeatable ways of working across the Product Organization.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2-5 years in product operations, program management, project management, product management, or a similar role, ideally within a technology or product-focused organization.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcomed.

Skill Set

Product Operations is a strategic support function for the business that is as much about coordinating people as it is technology and processes. The strongest candidates will be comfortable owning tactical, day-to-day operational work while building the skills to help identify ways to improve how the organization works over time.

Predominantly, candidates from product operations, program or project management, business operations, product management, business analysis, or similar roles may bring the right mix of execution, organization, and process improvement experience to the position.

  • An understanding of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including intake, discovery, assessment, planning, release, and cross-functional readiness processes.
  • Works iteratively and pragmatically - eager to help improve the way teams work over time without over-engineering or trying to change everything at once.
  • A logical and analytical mindset, with a developing ability to understand what can be changed, what value change can bring, and comfort using data to support recommendations.
  • An empathetic attitude to truly understand the problems you are trying to support and solve with your colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, resilience to change, and the ability to adapt while working across multiple priorities and teams.
  • Experience managing task management and workflow tools - e.g. Jira, Linear, Asana, Productboard, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to help maintain, organize, and refine knowledge bases and documentation structures using the most suitable information architecture and documentation solution at hand - e.g. Confluence, Notion, etc.
  • Ability to help use product, process, or operational data to support better decision-making and surface relevant insights from available reporting and analytics.
  • Experience supporting the administration, adoption, and improvement of software tools and workflows in general.
  • Comfort supporting meetings and presentations with multiple stakeholders, with growing confidence in facilitating and presenting over time.
  • Comfort working with all levels of the business - from senior leaders to individual contributors - and a willingness to make suggestions and support positive change under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership.

Compensation

Additional Information

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
